    return G

def sq_of(p,H,W): return {(p[0]+a,p[1]+b) for a in(0,1) for b in(0,1)}
for n in range(1,6):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; do_=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']

        s=sq_of(p,H,W)
        touch_r=(min(r for r,c in s)==0 or max(r for r,c in s)==H-1)
        touch_c=(min(c for r,c in s)==0 or max(c for r,c in s)==W-1)
        tag='border' if (touch_r or touch_c) else 'none'
        print(p,label=('kept' if p in K else 'drop'),'tag=',tag)
